note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The routes, their states and their end entries are supplied: a hand traces the routes supplied as concluded and lays a neutral filter clip on the ways supplied as pending a check. No finality doctrine is drawn or implied, and nothing says whether any route is closed or still available. The calendar marks no date. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations and finalState are editable.
